query:
SELECT
                    id           AS "id!: domain::RowID",
                    name,
                    is_active,
                    created_on   AS "created_on!: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>",
                    updated_on   AS "updated_on!: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>"
                FROM payees
                WHERE is_active = TRUE
                ORDER BY name ASC
